thread:
sam_platform: Finished deploy of slice-17 to prod at 10:05 PT. Doing a quick verification sweep — aiming to run smoke checks now. Can @alex.dev and @maria_pm confirm availability?

deploy-bot: rollout started for slice-17 (canary -> 100%). Logs: https://internal.deploys/redwood/slice-17 :rocket:

alex.dev: I can take the functional smoke (schema + inference). Starting in ~2m.

maria_pm: I'll watch dashboards and QA prompt set. tagging QA to run short prompt suite.

jordan_oncall: I'll monitor p50/p95, 5xx rate, and throttles. Alert if p95 > baseline+30ms or 5xx > 0.5%.

sam_platform: Quick checklist to validate (copy/paste):
```
1) curl https://api.prod.redwood/v1/health -> 200
2) ./scripts/smoke_prod.sh --slice=slice-17 --quick
3) Check latency dashboard: p50/p95, token/sec, and tail latency
4) Confirm KV cache warm (cache-hit ratio > 80%)
5) Verify no increase in model OOMs or GPU memory spikes
```

alex.dev: curl health -> 200. smoke script results: 9/10 tests passed. rerank_integration flaky (1/10 failures, timeout). Sharing trimmed logs: `rerank timeout after 2.5s`

maria_pm: Metrics after deploy (first 3m): p50 +3ms, p95 +7ms, error rate 0.04%, CPU/GPU normal. No tail spikes on embeddings route. :thumbsup:

jordan_oncall: No increase in 5xx. Trace sampling shows a few requests hitting retrier in front of rerank (timeout path). Keeping an eye.

sam_platform: For rerank flaky — can we try rerunning smoke with batchsize=1 and timeout bump to 3000ms? If that stabilizes, we can patch config and roll a tiny hotfix.

alex.dev: reran smoke with batchsize=1 and timeout=3000ms -> rerank passed 10/10. Repro seems tied to batching + timeout. I can push a config hotpatch to rollout to the slice.

maria_pm: Agree with hotpatch. Low risk change (timeout + batch tweak). If rollout increases errors, rollback immediately.

alex.dev: Pushing hotpatch now (config change: rerank.timeout_ms=3000, rerank.max_batch=8)
deploy-bot: config hotpatch initiated for slice-17 (3 hosts first).

alex.dev: Patch applied to 3/4 hosts, final host draining and applying...

alex.dev: Patch finished on all hosts. Rerunning smoke: ./scripts/smoke_prod.sh --slice=slice-17 --quick -> all tests passed 10/10.

maria_pm: Rechecked dashboards: p95 back to +5ms, errors stable 0.03%. KV cache warmed. No regressions on embeddings or chat routes.

jordan_oncall: Observability looks clean. No new 5xx, traces show improved tail latency for rerank.

sam_platform: Awesome — marking this deploy as verified. We'll keep the watch open for 15 more minutes, then clear the rollout channel if nothing else crops up. Thanks everyone! :tada:

alex.dev: Nice. I'll follow up with a short note to the release log about the timeout tweak and justification.

maria_pm: Adding a QA note: include rerank batch/timeout in next regression set.

jordan_oncall: Leaving a monitor for 30m just in case. Ping me if any alerts.

sam_platform: Closing watch after 15m unless anyone objects. If anything, reopen the thread. :wave:
